```{r setup, include = FALSE, echo = FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
SAVE_FIGS <- FALSE   # TRUE writes 300-dpi PNGs to ./figures 
save_fig <- function(p, name, w = 6.5, h = 4) {
  if (SAVE_FIGS) {
    dir.create("figures", showWarnings = FALSE)
    ggsave(file.path("figures", paste0(name, ".png")), p, width = w, height = h, dpi = 300)
  }
  invisible(p)
}

map_high   <- "#0288D1"

                               scale_linetype_manual(values = ltypes))

# ---------------- Table Theme -----------------
tbl_size <- 12  # the brief asks for Arial 12 throughout; reduce only if a wide table cannot fit

themed_table <- function(df, caption = NULL, align = NULL, size = tbl_size) {
  ft <- flextable(df)
  ft <- font(ft, fontname = "Arial", part = "all")
  ft <- fontsize(ft, size = size, part = "all")
  ft <- bg(ft, bg = map_high, part = "header")
  ft <- color(ft, color = "white", part = "header")
  ft <- bold(ft, part = "header")
  if (nrow(df) >= 2) ft <- bg(ft, i = seq(2, nrow(df), by = 2), 
                              bg = map_low, part = "body")
  ft <- border_remove(ft)
  ft <- hline(ft, border = officer::fp_border(color = map_na, width = 1), part = "body")
  ft <- hline_bottom(ft, border = officer::fp_border(color = blue_dark, 
                                                     width = 1.5), part = "body")
  if (!is.null(align)) {                      # e.g. "llr" = left, left, right
    al <- c(l = "left", c = "center", r = "right")[strsplit(align, "")[[1]]]
    for (k in seq_along(al)) ft <- align(ft, j = k, align = unname(al[k]), part = "all")
  }
  if (!is.null(caption)) ft <- set_caption(ft, caption = caption)
  autofit(ft)
}
```

Where does explanation instability come from? Tables and figures for the RQ3 discussion. Needs from the setup chunks: lab(), themed_table(), pal, scale_model(), base_theme (figures/table scripts). Reads only saved results. SD values are in log-frequency units; premium-equivalent = exp(SD) - 1.

```{r, echo=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)

models_b <- c("GLM", "GBM_selected", "ANN_selected")

arr_of   <- function(l) array(unlist(l), dim = c(nrow(l[[1]]), 
                                                 ncol(l[[1]]), length(l)),
                              # policy x feature x replicate
                              dimnames = list(NULL, colnames(l[[1]]), NULL)) 

# variance across replicates
cell_var <- function(l) apply(arr_of(l), c(1, 2), var)

# root-mean-square SD: sources add on this (variance) basis
rms_sd   <- function(l) sqrt(mean(cell_var(l)))     
pct      <- function(sd) 100 * (exp(sd) - 1)

# SD in log units -> premium-equivalent %
sd_pct   <- function(sd) sprintf("%.4f (%.1f%%)", sd, pct(sd))

# ---- Variable check: confirm that the saved columns are what the text says they are ------------
check <- data.frame(
  model = models_b,
  floor_saved      = stab$stab_axis1$mean_sd_phi[match(models_b, stab$stab_axis1$model)],
  floor_recomputed = sapply(models_b, function(m) mean(apply(arr_of(stab$noise_phi[[m]]), c(1, 2), sd))),
  refit_saved      = stab$stab_axis2$mean_sd_phi[match(models_b, stab$stab_axis2$model)],
  refit_recomputed = sapply(models_b, function(m) mean(apply(arr_of(stab$phi_refit[[m]]), c(1, 2), sd))),
  pred_sd_saved      = stab$stab_axis2$pred_sd[match(models_b, stab$stab_axis2$model)],
  pred_sd_recomputed = sapply(models_b, function(m) mean(apply(do.call(cbind, stab$fx_refit[[m]]), 1, sd))))
print(round(check[, -1], 4))
stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(check$floor_saved, check$floor_recomputed)),
          isTRUE(all.equal(check$refit_saved, check$refit_recomputed)),
          isTRUE(all.equal(check$pred_sd_saved, check$pred_sd_recomputed)))

themed_table(check) 
stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(check$floor_saved, check$floor_recomputed)),
          isTRUE(all.equal(check$refit_saved, check$refit_recomputed)),
          isTRUE(all.equal(check$pred_sd_saved, check$pred_sd_recomputed)))
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
# ---- Table 1: sources of attribution variation (root-mean-square SD, log units and premium %) ------
noise_rms <- sapply(models_b, function(m) rms_sd(stab$noise_phi[[m]]))
refit_rms <- sapply(models_b, function(m) rms_sd(stab$phi_refit[[m]]))
seed_rms  <- rms_sd(dec$seed_phi)                                     # five final ANNs, same background
stopifnot(abs(seed_rms^2 / refit_rms[["ANN_selected"]]^2 - dec$seed_share) < 1e-6)   # = dec$seed_share
data_rms  <- c(refit_rms[["GLM"]], refit_rms[["GBM_selected"]], sqrt(refit_rms[["ANN_selected"]]^2 - seed_rms^2))
sources <- data.frame(
  Source = c("Explainer noise (50-row background draw)", "Training seed (ANN only)",
             "Data sensitivity (refit on resampled data)", "Total under refits"),
  GLM  = c(sd_pct(noise_rms[["GLM"]]), "–", sd_pct(data_rms[1]), sd_pct(refit_rms[["GLM"]])),
  GBM  = c(sd_pct(noise_rms[["GBM_selected"]]), "–", sd_pct(data_rms[2]), sd_pct(refit_rms[["GBM_selected"]])),
  ANN  = c(sd_pct(noise_rms[["ANN_selected"]]), sd_pct(seed_rms), sd_pct(data_rms[3]), sd_pct(refit_rms[["ANN_selected"]])),
  check.names = FALSE)
tab_sources <- themed_table(sources, align = "lrrr",
  caption = paste("Sources of variation in a feature's SHAP attribution: SD in log units (premium-equivalent).",
                  "Explainer noise comes from a separate experiment and is not part of the refit total",
                  "(the refits use a fixed background). Root-mean-square basis, so seed and data parts add as variances."))
tab_sources
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
# ---- Table 2: prediction-driven movement versus reallocation ---------------------------------------
# Each attribution vector is split into its equal share of the policy's total and a zero-sum remainder.
# The remainder moves attribution between features without changing the total (pure reallocation).
# Derived measure: define it in Chapter 3 (glossary) before using it in the text.
decompose_sources <- function(l) {
  a <- arr_of(l); p <- dim(a)[2]
  s <- apply(a, c(1, 3), sum)                                   # attribution total per policy and replicate
  zero_sum <- a
  for (j in seq_len(p)) zero_sum[, j, ] <- a[, j, ] - s / p     # zero-sum (reallocation) part
  c(total_sd = mean(apply(s, 1, sd)),
    realloc_share = mean(apply(zero_sum, c(1, 2), var)) / mean(apply(a, c(1, 2), var)))
}
dec_refit <- t(sapply(models_b, function(m) decompose_sources(stab$phi_refit[[m]])))
dec_noise <- t(sapply(models_b, function(m) decompose_sources(stab$noise_phi[[m]])))
ix2 <- match(models_b, stab$stab_axis2$model); ix1 <- match(models_b, stab$stab_axis1$model)
realloc <- data.frame(
  Model = as.character(lab(models_b)),
  `SD of log-prediction across refits (pred_sd)` = sprintf("%.3f", stab$stab_axis2$pred_sd[ix2]),
  `SD of attribution total across refits`        = sprintf("%.3f", dec_refit[, "total_sd"]),
  `Profile distance, refits (profile_tv)`        = sprintf("%.3f", stab$stab_axis2$profile_tv[ix2]),
  `Profile distance, explainer noise`            = sprintf("%.3f", stab$stab_axis1$profile_tv[ix1]),
  `Reallocation share of variance, refits`       = sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * dec_refit[, "realloc_share"]),
  `Reallocation share of variance, explainer noise` = sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * dec_noise[, "realloc_share"]),
  check.names = FALSE)
tab_realloc <- themed_table(realloc, align = "lrrrrrr",
  caption = paste("Prediction-driven movement and reallocation. The first two columns should agree (the attribution",
                  "total moves with the prediction). Reallocation share is the share of attribution variance that",
                  "leaves the policy's total unchanged."))
tab_realloc
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
# ---- Table 3 and Figure 1: which features drive the instability ---------------------------------------
feats_all <- colnames(stab$phi_refit$GLM[[1]])
feature_tab <- do.call(rbind, lapply(models_b, function(m) {
  v_refit <- colMeans(cell_var(stab$phi_refit[[m]])); v_noise <- colMeans(cell_var(stab$noise_phi[[m]]))
  data.frame(model = m, feature = feats_all, refit_pct = pct(sqrt(v_refit)), floor_pct = pct(sqrt(v_noise)),
             share_of_refit_variance = 100 * v_refit / sum(v_refit))
}))
ann_order <- feature_tab$feature[feature_tab$model == "ANN_selected"][
  order(feature_tab$refit_pct[feature_tab$model == "ANN_selected"])]
feature_tab$feature <- factor(feature_tab$feature, levels = ann_order)
feature_tab$lab <- lab(feature_tab$model)

wide_share <- reshape(feature_tab[, c("model", "feature", "share_of_refit_variance")],
                      idvar = "feature", timevar = "model", direction = "wide")
wide_share <- wide_share[order(-wide_share$share_of_refit_variance.ANN_selected), ]
tab_features <- themed_table(
  data.frame(Feature = as.character(wide_share$feature),
             GLM = sprintf("%.0f%%", wide_share$share_of_refit_variance.GLM),
             GBM = sprintf("%.0f%%", wide_share$share_of_refit_variance.GBM_selected),
             ANN = sprintf("%.0f%%", wide_share$share_of_refit_variance.ANN_selected)),
  align = "lrrr", caption = "Share of total refit variance in attributions contributed by each feature.")
tab_features
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
# ---- Figure 2: which policies (instability by predicted-risk decile) -------------------------------------
# The stability sample is stored in equal blocks by risk decile (decile 1 first).
n_pol <- nrow(stab$phi_refit$GLM[[1]]); dec_of_policy <- rep(1:10, each = n_pol / 10)
by_decile <- do.call(rbind, lapply(models_b, function(m) {
  v <- rowMeans(cell_var(stab$phi_refit[[m]]))                       # per-policy variance, averaged over features
  data.frame(model = m, decile = 1:10, refit_pct = pct(sqrt(tapply(v, dec_of_policy, mean))))
}))
by_decile$lab <- lab(by_decile$model)
fig_deciles <- ggplot(by_decile, aes(x = decile, y = refit_pct, colour = lab, shape = lab, linetype = lab, group = lab)) +
  geom_line() + geom_point(size = 1.8) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:10) + scale_model() +
  labs(x = "Predicted-risk decile (1 = lowest)", y = "SD of attribution across refits (premium-equivalent, %)") +
  base_theme

# ---- Headline premium-equivalent figures (mean-SD basis, as in the stability table) ---------------------
headline_premium <- data.frame(model = models_b,
                               premium_pct = 100 * stab$stab_axis2$premium_equiv[ix2],
                               floor_pct   = 100 * stab$stab_axis1$premium_equiv[ix1])
print(headline_premium)
```
